veranderings.blok: Wat die lae vir ons sê
veranderings.voor: is 'n fossiel laer af ook vroeër toegemaak
veranderings.na: is 'n fossiel wat laer af lê, ook vroeër toegemaak
veranderings.rede: The bare adverb phrase 'laer af' after the noun reads elliptically; a short relative clause makes clear it is the fossil lying lower down.

veranderings.voor: Wat 'n plant of dier van lank gelede
veranderings.na: Iets wat 'n plant of dier van lank gelede
veranderings.rede: A glossary definition reads better as a noun phrase than as a headless relative clause starting with 'Wat'.
